name: Channel Breakout Strategy
description: Price momentum-based technical strategy using rolling highs/lows. Long when price breaks above Y-period rolling high, exit when falls below X-period rolling low. Sharpe ~2.04 on Top 10 crypto universe.
author: Jarvis - External Research (GitHub/adamkucson)

entry_rules.long: Price breaks above Y-period rolling high
entry_rules.short: Price breaks below Y-period rolling high (optional)

exit_rules.long: Price falls below X-period rolling low
exit_rules.short: Price rises above X-period rolling high (optional)

position_size.description: Position size as fraction of capital per signal

research_notes.key_insight: Fixed-weight allocation essential. Fully-invested approaches produced -70% drawdowns. Quality beats quantity.
